name: True North 5 Person Outdoor Quattro Cedar Cabin Sauna
description: Description This beautiful cabin sauna is handmade in Ontario, Canada. It has been developed for outdoor use in nature and can withstand any weather. Includes 2 front windows & glass door and you can choose if you want a wood stove or an electric heater inside. Sauna comes as a kit that requires assembly . Features: Seats 5 people Made From White Cedar- Strong and resistant to rot and decay, has a beautiful light-colored finish. Comes standard with roof membrane & 2nd layer of roof boards Fascia boards to protect the end grain of the wood 2 tier benches for sitting or reclining Partially pre-assembled construction with built-in venting holes Also Includes: 3 peg towel hanger, Vent kit and cover, Screws for assembly, Door handles, Glass door, Benches Two front windows are standard Optional rear window Optional porch: Depth of sauna is extended to add either a 1' or 2' covered porch with seating to cool off Specifications Specifications: Seats: 5 people Dimensions: 8'wide x 6/7/8'deep depending on porch selection x 7'tall Wood: White Cedar Walls: 1.55" thick solid wood Door: Wood-framed glass Made in: Canada Included Includes: Pre-cut wood for full sauna structure Roof membrane Vents w/ covers Prefab premium 2 tier benches Flat floor 2x Front windows, Door w/ glass window Optional porch w/ seats Clothes hanger 3-peg Hardware Screws Head Rests Installation guide Assembly Assembly Guide True North Quattro Sauna
